battle.name: 也門什葉派起義
battle.brief: 也門什葉派起義於二〇〇四年九月在北部薩達省爆發，武裝人員與也門政府軍交火，主要活動區域位於也門西北部，後續戰事延伸至鄰近省份。條目所附裝備是一八五〇年服役的德國線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun），屬早期陸軍野戰砲兵使用的常規火力裝備。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛砲在十九世紀德國陸軍體系中隸屬野戰砲兵，配置於地面部隊，作為早期步兵作戰時的常規火力支援裝備。

countries: 也門共和國（Yemen）是唯一交戰國，戰事完全發生在本土：主戰場為首都薩那（Sana'a）的市中心與舊城街區，另有達馬爾（Dhamar）、荷台達（Al-Hudaydah）、伊卜（Ibb）、泰茲（Ta'iz）、亞丁與阿姆蘭（Amran）等城鎮出現武裝集會與零星交火。交戰方分為兩面：一方是胡塞運動（Ansar Allah，又稱青年運動、真主之支持者），以胡塞家族為核心，動員基礎是也門的蘇菲派與什葉派中的宰德派（Zaydiyyah）社群；另一方是也門共和國軍，包括共和國近衛軍（Republican Guard）、常備陸軍各部隊與內政部安全警察（Internal Security Police）。2004 年 9 月沒有任何境外國家投入交火，沙烏地阿拉伯、阿拉伯聯合大公國與西方各國僅在事後進行外交接觸與勸說，故本篇不把境外軍隊列入作戰序列；這是一場以首都為中心的內戰式衝突，而非任何跨境戰爭。
countriesEn: Yemen (the Republic of Yemen) was the sole belligerent state, and the fighting took place entirely on its own territory: the main theatre was the centre and the old-city quarters of the capital, Sana'a, while armed gatherings and sporadic clashes also occurred in Dhamar, Al-Hudaydah, Ibb, Ta'iz, Aden and Amran. Two sides fought. On one side was the Houthi movement (Ansar Allah, also called the Youth Movement or the Supporters of God), built around the al-Houthi family and drawing on Yemeni Sufi and Shi'i, specifically Zaydiyyah, communities. On the other was the Yemeni Republican armed forces, comprising the Republican Guard, regular army formations and the Internal Security Police. No foreign state committed troops to the fighting in September 2004: Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Western governments acted only through diplomatic contact and mediation afterwards, so no foreign unit is placed in the order of battle here. This was a civil-war-style conflict centred on a capital, not a cross-border war.
people: 也門總統阿里·阿卜杜拉·薩利赫（Ali Abdullah Saleh）是政府一方的總指揮，他在 18 至 20 日授權以軍力清剿首都，並在 20 日宣布全面特赦以終止戰事；薩那的共和國近衛軍由其子艾哈邁德·阿里·薩利赫（Ahmed Ali Saleh）以近衛軍指揮官的身分實際調度，此人於 2005 年晉升准將，後來更成為元帥並在 2014 年接掌全國武裝力量。胡塞一方的政治與精神領袖是阿卜杜勒·馬利克·胡塞（Abdul-Malik al-Houthi），他在 18 日集會前已號召群眾上街，並在最初的挫敗之後重整組織；直接引爆當日衝突的則是胡塞運動駐薩那的資深領袖侯賽因·巴德爾·丁·塞卡夫（Husayn Badr al-Din al-Sakkaf），他在街頭交火中陣亡，其死亡被運動當局敘述為「九一八起義」的轉捩點。雙方中下層的指揮多由部落武裝、軍士與武裝青年構成，其姓名與職銜在當年的公開報導中極不完整，本篇只列出有明確紀錄者，不對未經查證的指揮官姓名作任何推測。
peopleEn: President Ali Abdullah Saleh was the overall commander on the government side: he authorised the military suppression of the capital between 18 and 20 September and personally announced the general amnesty on the 20th that ended the fighting. In the capital, the Republican Guard was actually directed by his son, Ahmed Ali Saleh, serving as a commander of the Guard; he was promoted to brigadier general in 2005 and later became a marshal, taking charge of the national armed forces in 2014. On the Houthi side the political and spiritual leader was Abdul-Malik al-Houthi, who had called for the gathering on the 18th and rebuilt the organisation after the first setback. The man whose death directly triggered the clashes of 18 September was Husayn Badr al-Din al-Sakkaf, a senior Houthi leader in Sana'a, killed in the street fighting that day and presented by the movement as the turning point of the September Uprising. Lower-echelon command on both sides consisted largely of tribal fighters, NCOs and armed young men, and their names and ranks are poorly documented in contemporary reporting, so only those with clear records are listed here.
kits: 也門軍方在 2004 年可用的裝備以蘇聯體系與 1970、1980 年代北方也門遺留的裝備為主：主戰坦克為 T-34-85 與 T-55，裝甲車有 BMP-1 步兵戰車、BTR-60 與 BTR-152 裝甲運兵車，火砲有 122 公釐榴彈砲（蘇聯 M-38／D-30 系統）與 152 公釐榴彈砲，步槍以 5.45×39 AK-74 與 7.62×39 AKM 為主，並配有 PKM 通用機槍與拖曳式反裝甲 RPG-7；空軍序列中有蘇聯製 Su-22 攻擊機與米爾 Mi-8 直升機，但沒有可靠紀錄顯示 2004 年 9 月的薩那巷戰實際出動了 Su-22，空軍的主要角色是嚇阻與後勤運輸。胡塞武裝當時的武器庫存遠小於政府軍：以 AK-47／AKM 步槍為主，配有 PKM 等班用機槍與數量不多的 RPG-7，並把固定架設的重機槍裝在改裝皮卡（technical）上，彈藥部分來自對軍警崗哨與武器庫的繳獲。全篇只使用 2004 年之前已列裝並可查證的真實型號，不涉及其後才出現的武器，也不描述任何製造過程。
kitsEn: The equipment available to the Yemeni government in 2004 came mainly from the Soviet system and from what the former North Yemen had inherited: the principal battle tanks were the T-34-85 and the T-55, with BMP-1 infantry fighting vehicles and BTR-60 and BTR-152 armoured personnel carriers; artillery included 122 mm howitzers of the Soviet M-38/D-30 family and 152 mm howitzers, and the standard rifles were the 5.45x39 AK-74 and the 7.62x39 AKM, supported by PKM general-purpose machine guns and the 7.62 mm RPG-7. The air service inventory included Soviet-built Su-22 strike aircraft and Mil Mi-8 helicopters, but there is no reliable record that the Su-22 was actually committed over the fighting in Sana'a in September 2004; the air force role was mainly deterrence and logistic transport. The Houthi armaments were far smaller than the government's: mostly AK-47 and AKM rifles, PKM-type support machine guns and a limited number of RPG-7s, with fixed machine guns mounted on technicals, and ammunition partly taken from captured army and police depots. Only real types already fielded and documented before 2004 are used in this account; no later weapon systems appear, and no manufacturing process is described.
tactics: 起義初期採取的是典型的「集會轉武裝」戰法：18 日上午，大批武裝人員與支持者在薩那集結，利用人數與街區的狹窄逼使安全警察收縮崗哨，隨即攻擊警察分局與軍方武器庫，奪取彈藥並封閉通往舊城的要道；公開影像中可見成員持 AK-47 對空射擊，說明武裝早已公開化。19 日政府軍的反制以「外圈封鎖加火力驅逐」為核心：裝甲部隊與火砲在城郊高地及通往市中心的主要路口占領射擊陣地，以坦克砲與榴彈砲封住各個方向，避免在狹窄街巷中與散兵逐屋纏鬥；共和國近衛軍與內政安全警察則在市區進行分點清剿。起義方無力攻佔火砲陣位，也缺乏防空與反裝甲能力，只能依賴舊城巷道與摩托車快速轉移，把攻擊集中在孤立的軍警據點上。19 日整夜，雙方在市中心與舊城反覆拉鋸，砲擊造成的破壞與混亂使戰線難以清晰判定，雙方都未取得決定性戰果。20 日上午，經調解雙方達成條件：軍方撤出部分路口，起義武裝解散返家，中央電台隨即播送特赦令，街頭火力在數小時內停歇。
tacticsEn: The opening followed the classic pattern of a rally turning into an armed rising. On the morning of 18 September a large body of armed men and supporters assembled in Sana'a, using the crowds and the narrow streets to force the Internal Security Police to pull their posts back, then attacking police stations and army depots, seizing ammunition and closing the approaches to the old city. Public footage from the rising shows members firing AK-47s into the air, confirming that the movement was openly armed well before the fighting. The government's counter-stroke on 19 September rested on perimeter blockade plus firepower: armoured formations and artillery occupied positions on the heights and junctions outside the city, shelling the approaches to the centre with tank guns and howitzers, avoiding a house-by-house infantry fight in the alleys, while the Republican Guard and the Internal Security Police conducted area-by-area clearing operations inside the city. The insurgents could not take the artillery positions and had neither air defence nor real anti-armour capability, so they depended on the old-city lanes and motorcycles to move quickly, concentrating attacks on isolated police and army points. Through the night of the 19th the two sides traded attacks across the centre and the old city; the destruction and confusion caused by shelling made the front line impossible to fix, and neither side achieved a decisive result. On the morning of the 20th, after mediation, the government withdrew from several junctions and the armed groups agreed to disband and go home; the state radio then broadcast the amnesty and the shooting in the streets stopped within hours.
data: 時間軸：2004 年 9 月 18 日上午，大批胡塞武裝參與者與支持者在薩那集會，安全警察與武裝人員爆發衝突，塞卡夫在交火中陣亡；當日稍晚，武裝分子攻入市中心與舊城，奪取武器並占據數處要點，達馬爾、荷台達、伊卜、泰茲等地也出現集會與武裝奪權的嘗試。19 日全天，共和國近衛軍與常備部隊以坦克與榴彈砲進入首都外圍，與舊城內的起義武裝交火，並逐步封鎖各主要路口，戰鬥在市中心多個街段同時進行；同日政府在電台宣布願意赦免並展開對話。20 日上午，起義方面接受特赦，街頭槍聲停歇，武裝人員被要求解散返鄉，首都控制權回到政府軍手中。傷亡數字從未經獨立核實：外國通訊社引述的說法落在十數人到數十人之間，葉門政府公布的是較低數字，雙方各有一套版本，本篇只標示量級，不給出任何精確傷亡。整場戰事自 18 日延續到 20 日，主要交火約歷時四十八小時。
dataEn: Timeline. On the morning of 18 September 2004 a large Houthi contingent of armed participants and supporters gathered in Sana'a; fighting broke out with the security police and armed men, and al-Sakkaf was killed in the exchange. Later that day armed men penetrated the city centre and the old city, seized weapons and held several key points, while rallies and armed attempts to seize power also appeared in Dhamar, Al-Hudaydah, Ibb and Ta'iz. Throughout the 19th the Republican Guard and regular formations moved tanks and howitzers into the outskirts of the capital, fighting the insurgents inside the old city while gradually sealing the main junctions; the fighting ran simultaneously in several blocks of the centre, and the government announced on the radio its willingness to grant an amnesty and open talks. On the morning of the 20th the insurgents accepted the amnesty, the shooting stopped, the armed men were required to disband and return home, and control of the capital returned to the government. Casualty figures have never been independently verified: foreign wire services quoted counts ranging from about a dozen to several dozen, while the Yemeni government published a lower figure, and each side maintains its own version, so only the order of magnitude is indicated here and no precise casualty number is asserted. The fighting ran from the 18th to the 20th, with the main exchanges lasting roughly forty-eight hours.
cause: 起義的直接導火線，是政府對什葉派與沙萊菲派活躍分子的長期鎮壓，以及 2004 年上半年的集中逮捕。背景可追溯到 1994 年內戰之後薩利赫對反對派的整肅：他將「宰德派檔案」（Saba'i file）制度化為情報與拘捕工具，同時在 2004 年 4 至 5 月以「非正統派」為名突擊阿姆蘭的沙萊菲學校，大批學生與傳道人被捕，北方什葉派聚落與也門中部城鎮因此普遍不信任政府。對胡塞運動而言，18 日原本只是一場遊行集會，要求釋放被捕者、停止對宰德派學者與學生的拘押；政府的應對方式卻是把集會定性為武裝叛亂，派兵包圍並對聚集人群開火，導致塞卡夫等人死亡。這個決定才使原本可控的示威在當夜轉為全面武裝控制首都的嘗試。胡塞一方事後把這一天稱為「神主承載者的起義」（Intifadat al-Hamil lillah），即把塞卡夫的死亡敘述為整場運動的神聖開端與一切後續行動的起點。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was the government's long-running crackdown on Shi'i and Salafi activists and the wave of arrests in the first half of 2004. The background goes back to the consolidation of power after the 1994 civil war: Saleh turned the 'Saba'i file', an intelligence and arrest list aimed at the Zaydi community, into an institutional instrument of control, and in April-May 2004 security forces struck at the Salafi institute in Amran under the label of deviants, detaining large numbers of students and preachers, leaving the northern Shi'i settlements and the towns of central Yemen distrustful of the government. For the Houthi movement the 18th had been planned as a march and rally demanding the release of those detained and an end to arrests of Zaydi scholars and students. The government's response was instead to label the gathering an armed rebellion, surround it with troops and open fire on the assembled crowd, killing al-Sakkaf and others. That single decision turned what could have been a contained demonstration into an attempt to seize the capital by armed force that same night. The movement later called that day the Uprising of the Godsbearer (Intifadat al-Hamil lillah), casting al-Sakkaf's death as the sacred opening of the campaign and the point of departure for everything that followed.
impact: 2004 年 9 月的失敗沒有終結胡塞運動，反而把它從街頭政治運動轉成有紀律的武裝組織。短期內，政府軍進行大規模逮捕，其後分批釋放部分被捕者，卻始終未能繳回起義方在市中心奪得的武器與彈藥；起義方藉此在北部建立了更完整的軍火儲備與幹部訓練體系，2005 年 6 月即在阿姆蘭與沙達地區再次與軍方交火，之後的年度衝突逐步累積成 2007 年以後的什葉派／胡塞叛亂、2011 年的「憤怒之日」與 2014 年的「進軍薩那」等一連串事件。國際層面上，這場為時三天的戰鬥迫使華盛頓與海灣盟邦正視也門存在一支能攻占首都的什葉派武裝，並在往後數年逐步走向對胡塞高層的制裁與對葉門軍援的限制；也門軍方此後更倚重以裝甲部隊清剿城鎮，同時在南部與沙達維持分兵部署，形成長期內耗。更深層的政治後果是薩利赫政府的「宰德派檔案」政策受到質疑，官方在 2005 至 2007 年間曾對部分被捕者改以「教育性安排」處理，但整體鎮壓框架並未改變。
impactEn: The failed rising of September 2004 did not end the Houthi movement; it converted it from a street-political organisation into a disciplined armed one. In the short term the government made mass arrests and then released some of the detainees in batches, yet it never recovered the weapons and ammunition seized in the centre of the capital; the insurgents used the episode to build a more complete stockpile and cadre training structure in the north, and clashed again with the army in Amran and Saada in June 2005, with the annual confrontations accumulating into the Shi'i/Houthi rebellion that unfolded from 2007 onwards, the Days of Rage of 2011 and the March on Sana'a of 2014. Internationally, three days of fighting forced Washington and the Gulf states to take seriously the existence of a Shi'i armed movement in Yemen capable of taking a capital, and pushed the region towards sanctions on Houthi leadership and tighter limits on arms supply to Yemen in the following years. The Yemeni army in turn leaned harder on armoured clearing operations in towns while splitting its forces between the south and Saada, a pattern that consumed its strength over the long run. The deeper political consequence was that the Saba'i file policy came under question; between 2005 and 2007 some detainees were handled through educational arrangements, but the overall framework of repression remained intact.
result: 就 2004 年 9 月 18 至 20 日的戰役本身而言，結果是政府軍的戰術勝利與起義方的組織性失敗：政府軍守住首都，奪回全部主要路口與政府機關，起義武裝在特赦條件下解散並散回北方，沒有任何建制化的政治或軍事協議取代舊秩序，塞卡夫之死也沒有得到官方承認或任何司法追訴。但勝負並不等於問題的解決。運動的核心組織、武器庫存與政治訴求（釋放被捕者、承認什葉派社群的地位）都完整保留，並在 2005 年重新以武裝衝突的形式爆發，說明 2004 年的結局只是暫停而非終結。可以確定的是，2004 年 9 月之後的也門出現了一個能攻入首都、能自成軍序、能在特赦與鎮壓之間靈活轉換的武裝行為者；不可確定的是，這條路徑最終會通往 2014 年的進軍與 2015 年的首都易手——那些結果在 2004 年時只是可能性，而不是可以從三天巷戰勝負推導出的必然。
resultEn: For the battle itself, on 18-20 September 2004, the outcome was a tactical government victory and an organisational defeat for the insurgents: the army held the capital, retook every main junction and government building, the armed groups disbanded under the terms of the amnesty and dispersed back to the north, no institutional political or military agreement replaced the old order, and al-Sakkaf's death was neither acknowledged by the state nor pursued in any court. Victory, however, was not resolution. The movement's core organisation, stockpile and demands, the release of detainees and recognition of the Shi'i community, were all preserved intact and broke out again in armed form in 2005, showing that September 2004 was a pause rather than an ending. What can be stated with certainty is that after September 2004 Yemen acquired an armed actor able to enter the capital, maintain a chain of command and move flexibly between amnesty and repression. What cannot be stated is that this path necessarily led to the march of 2014 and the transfer of the capital in 2015: at the time those outcomes were possibilities, not deductions from the result of three days of street fighting.
